newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Surgutneftegaz to make bonus share issue.
newsitem.headline: Russian Surgutneftegaz to make bonus share issue.

text.p: Russian oil company AO Surgutneftegaz's plans an increase in authorised but unissued capital, a spokesman said on Monday.

He could not say the volume of the increase, but said that shares from the increase would be distributed among shareholders in proportion to their holding in the company. The proposal would be put to an extraordinary shareholders' meeting at the end of June, he said.
The capital increase, to compensate for a revaluation of assets, will include ordinary and preferred shares, he said.
Surgutneftegaz's authorised capital is 5.998 trillion roubles, split into 4.623 billion ordinary shares and 1.374 preferred shares with a face value of 1,000 roubles each (differences due rounding).
Surgutneftegaz is the main production unit of one of Russia's vertically integrated oil groups, Surgut Holding (NK Surgutneftegaz).
